name: atlas-mt5-trade-watch
description: Read-only XAUUSD demo feed for the Atlas Trade Watch.

interface.shortDescription: Read fresh XAUUSD demo quotes and completed candles.
interface.longDescription: Connects to the Atlas MT5 demo relay for read-only feed status, XAUUSD quotes, contract details and completed candles. It cannot access account balances, positions, orders, history or trading actions.
defaultPrompt: Check whether my XAUUSD demo feed is fresh.
Read the latest completed XAUUSD M5 candles.
